inputs.cite: R4 D1 via G3b Check; R4-D1-spike.md Table A and para after Table C (quoted, not rerun)

day.reading: either the specific fixations matter (Darwillion) or they are interchangeable and neutral
day.holds: at locus granularity lambda 0.1-6 is below the flip (specific horn stands, R4 D1); 'neutral is not functional' is valid

critic.reading: history needs some 20 million out of a large pool, so P_any is about 1
critic.holds: 527 SD below the mean, P(K < k) <= 10^-62,689 under k = mu; the middle case exists and flips at lambda_50 = 12.3-17.2 (adaptive subset only)

notes: P_any near 1 holds only under McCarthy's neutral k = mu supply, which branch B contests. Day's dilemma (G3b) has two horns; the middle case, k of M interchangeable adaptive alternatives, is a third, with a sharp flip at lambda_50 = -ln(1 - 2^(-1/n_f)): 12.33 at n_f = 157,000, 17.18 at 2e7, band 4.07 wide. R4 G1's n_f = 1,000 row prints 7.28 where the closed form gives 7.275 (a rounding slip, 0.07%; the 12.3-17.2 band is unaffected). The R4 D1 values (per-locus lambda 0.1-6; a gene-level pool of 51 proxy-beneficial SNVs clears the flip for about ten needed changes at s = 0.01, not 25, not at s = 0.001) are measurements quoted with locators.
